name: Sharpened-responsibility NLL + var floor + entropy
tagline: Blend of standard logsumexp NLL and a softmax-temperature-sharpened detached-responsibility NLL, with a variance-floor ReLU penalty and a mixing-weight entropy bonus.

key_hyperparams.name: blend (std/sharp)
key_hyperparams.role: weights between marginal and sharpened NLL

init_recovers: Standard NLL when sharp blend = 0, var_weight = 0, entropy_weight = 0
diff_from_baseline: Compared to default NLL and the nll_entropy baseline, replaces the entropy-only regularizer with a 60/40 blend of marginal NLL and a temperature-sharpened-responsibility NLL (responsibilities detached, tau=0.5), plus a ReLU(v_min - sigma^2) penalty on component variances and a mixing-weight entropy bonus.

name: Vanilla NLL (no change)
tagline: Returns -dist.log_prob(target).mean(); identical to the robomimic default loss.

key_hyperparams.name: action_dim
key_hyperparams.role: stored only; does not affect the loss

diff_from_baseline: No change vs the 'default' baseline. The class is the standard GMM NLL with no extra terms; the docstring even labels it 'Vanilla NLL loss'.

name: Variance-clamped NLL + WTA SmoothL1 + assignment CE
tagline: Down-weight gripper in NLL with std clamped to 0.01, add 50x SmoothL1 from the closest-mode mean, and 5x cross-entropy pushing logits onto that mode.
init_recovers: Per-dim weighted NLL when L1 and CE coefficients are 0
diff_from_baseline: Compared to the weighted_nll baseline (which weights positional dims 2x and gripper 1x by rescaling targets), this proposal: (1) implements the per-dimension Gaussian log-prob manually with a hard scale floor of 0.01 (variance clamp) and gripper down-weight 0.1 in NLL, (2) adds a 50x weighted SmoothL1 (beta=0.01) loss between the target and the mean of the closest mode (WTA argmin in Euclidean space, gripper ignored), and (3) adds a 5x CE pushing the mixing logits onto that closest mode.

name: Tempered posterior distillation + Mahalanobis anchor
tagline: NLL plus a KL between the policy mixture logits and a tempered detached posterior, plus a responsibility-weighted standardized-MSE anchor with mild gripper up-weight.

key_hyperparams.name: gripper_weight
key_hyperparams.role: per-dim weight on the last action component (anchor only)

diff_from_baseline: Builds on the default NLL and is closer to nll_entropy but replaces the entropy bonus with two distillation-style terms: a KL between policy mixing logits and a temperature-1.5-softened detached posterior over modes (forces specialization without WTA brittleness), and a responsibility-weighted standardized MSE anchor that pulls the closest mode's mean toward the demo (gripper dim weighted 1.5x).

name: Joint-log-marginal NLL + log-sigma box + balance
tagline: Manual GMM NLL via logsumexp, plus quadratic ReLU penalties pinning log sigma into [-3, -0.5] and an MSE on mixing probs vs uniform.

key_hyperparams.name: best_weight
key_hyperparams.role: scaling of marginal NLL (named best_nll despite using logsumexp)

diff_from_baseline: Compared to the default and nll_entropy baselines, recomputes the GMM log-prob by hand to keep numerical control, then adds two regularizers: a quadratic ReLU pair pinning log component sigma inside [-3, -0.5] (prevents collapse and over-spread), and a uniform-target MSE on mixing probabilities (replaces the usual entropy bonus). NOTE: the variable named best_nll is actually the standard logsumexp marginal NLL, despite the docstring describing 'best-component NLL'.
